place.source_title: Old Harmar Post Office (Lydia Young notary shop), Gilman Avenue

brief: Tiny two-storey frame building of 1864, one room wide, gable end to the street: pale blue clapboard with a slight lean, a door and shop window below with a small porch and steps, one window above, and a POST OFFICE board over the door; built as a notary's shop and later the village post office.

facade.notes: the old Harmar post office (Marietta OH, 1864): a tiny two-storey gable-front frame building painted blue with a POST OFFICE sign over the door, a later side deck; set on a lawn beside a museum railroad caboose and passenger car

why.note: a village post office in a house-sized building (the notary's shop)
